prompt: Perform a short real-tool protein workflow. First call retrieve_protein_structure_by_gene_name for human TP53 using the live schema. From its successful observation, take the returned protein structure artifact and call fix_pdb with remove_water=true, remove_heterogens=true, and add_hydrogens=false. Do not invent or hard-code the retrieved artifact. Return an e2e final_answer reporting the fixed PDB artifact and concise evidence from both real observations.

Perform a short real-tool molecule workflow for the SMILES CCO. Validate it with is_valid_smiles, then call visualize_molecule with the same SMILES. Return an e2e final_answer containing the canonical image artifact and concise evidence from both real observations. Do not claim success before the observations arrive.

Test the supported local tool environment. Use Read to inspect skills/L1_tools/molclaw-smiles-valid-check/SKILL.md. Then use Write to create run_log.md in the task workspace with a one-line note that the L1 document was loaded, and use Read to read run_log.md back. Return an e2e final_answer reporting the verified local log artifact and evidence from the Read, Write, and Read observations.
